parties:
ALI JAN JUTE MILLS LIMITED
Vs.
ALHAJ AHAMMED FAZLUR RAHMAN AND OTHERS
full_judgment: 6. After hearing, the trial Court decreed the suit in favour with the plaintiffs contending that in dealing with company matters, spirit and substance of the provisions are to be looked into and as per promoter's agreement an area of 39.035 acres of land has been transferred in favour of the plaintiffs. Although Fakir Chand executed a deed of disclaimer regarding 32.1275 acres of land in favour of the company but as per promoter's agreement exhibit-2 total land has been transferred. The heirs of Fakir Chand has no right or authority to execute and register the impugned, deeds as after earlier transfer they have no title and interest over the suit land. RS khatian regarding the total quantum of land has been prepared in the name of Ministry of Jute and Ali Jan Jute Mills paid all rents for the entire land. Defendant No. 1 Md. Fazlur Rahman, managing director of the company has no authority to transfer the suit land by the impugned deeds which has not been supported by any resolution of the company and the documentary evidence proves that Fakir Chand transferred his title and interest in favour of the Jute Mill and P.W. 1-4 by giving credible evidence proved the title and possession of the plaintiffs over the suit land.
